dict.string: Sorty
Sorty organizes files and folders using AI providers and storage locations you configure. It can also sign in to AI subscriptions, check for app updates, and optionally load contributor data.
https://github.com/shirishpothi/Sorty
Essential
Sorty connects to a local Ollama server when you choose Ollama as your AI provider.
If you deny these connections, Sorty cannot use local Ollama models.
api.openai.com
Essential
Sorty sends AI requests to OpenAI when you choose an OpenAI API key.
If you deny these connections, OpenAI API-powered organization and model checks will fail.
chatgpt.com,auth.openai.com
Essential
Sorty invokes Codex CLI for ChatGPT subscription inference and account authorization when you choose subscription authentication.
If you deny these connections, ChatGPT subscription sign-in and organization will fail.
api.groq.com
Essential
Sorty sends AI requests to Groq when you choose Groq.
If you deny these connections, Groq-powered organization and model checks will fail.
openrouter.ai
Essential
Sorty sends AI requests to OpenRouter when you choose OpenRouter.
If you deny these connections, OpenRouter-powered organization and model checks will fail.
api.anthropic.com
Essential
Sorty sends AI requests to Anthropic when you choose Claude.
If you deny these connections, Claude-powered organization and model checks will fail.
generativelanguage.googleapis.com
Essential
Sorty sends AI requests to Google when you choose Gemini.
If you deny these connections, Gemini-powered organization and model checks will fail.
www.googleapis.com
Essential
Sorty uses the Google Drive API to update file metadata and organize items in Google Drive locations.
If you deny these connections, Google Drive organization and metadata updates will fail.
us.i.posthog.com
Optional
With your consent, Sorty sends anonymous, privacy-filtered product analytics and retrieves experimental feature flags from PostHog.
If you deny these connections, analytics and experimental feature flags will remain unavailable; file organization continues normally.
o4511816291844096.ingest.us.sentry.io
Optional
With your consent, Sorty sends privacy-filtered crash, error, hang, and performance reports to Sentry.
If you deny these connections, reliability reports cannot be delivered; file organization continues normally.
opencode.ai
Essential
Sorty sends AI requests to OpenCode when you choose OpenCode Zen or OpenCode Go.
If you deny these connections, OpenCode-powered organization and model checks will fail.
github.com
Essential
Sorty checks for and downloads app updates hosted on GitHub Releases.
If you deny these connections, in-app update delivery will fail.
api.github.com
Essential
Sorty calls GitHub APIs for release metadata checks and optional contributor data.
If you deny these connections, release checks and contributor data loading may fail.
*.githubusercontent.com
GitHub may redirect release asset downloads to GitHub content delivery hosts during updates.
If you deny these connections, update downloads may fail even if release checks succeed.
Sorty can connect to custom API endpoints you configure for OpenAI-compatible providers, and to direct image URLs you explicitly provide for notifications.
If you deny these connections, custom provider requests and externally hosted notification images may fail.
Fallback entry for hostnames not covered above when you configure custom providers or explicit external URLs.
If you deny these connections, user-configured network features may not work.
